data.rationale: The commit moves the optimizer callback (qp_callback) to a point after the join-removal and self-join elimination (SJE) restart loop in query_planner(). This ensures that Aggref.aggpresorted flags, which are set during qp_callback to optimize pathkeys for grouping and aggregation, are not left in a stale or inconsistent state if the planner restarts due to a join being removed. The fix is reached by queries combining self-joins or removable joins on unique columns with multiple DISTINCT aggregates, which are the primary users of the aggpresorted optimization.
seeds: SELECT count(DISTINCT a1.c1), sum(DISTINCT a2.c1) FROM t1 a1 JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.c0 = a2.c0;
SELECT count(DISTINCT a1.c1), count(DISTINCT a1.c0), sum(DISTINCT a2.c1) FROM t1 a1 LEFT JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.c0 = a2.c0;
SET LOCAL enable_self_join_elimination = ON; SELECT a1.c1, count(DISTINCT a1.c0), sum(DISTINCT a2.c1) FROM t1 a1 JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.c0 = a2.c0 GROUP BY a1.c1 ORDER BY 1;
EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) SELECT count(DISTINCT a1.c1), sum(DISTINCT a2.c1) FROM t1 a1 JOIN t1 a2 USING (c0);
